title: Accounts Basis — Invoicing, Due Dates, Payments and Credits on the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Accounts Basis — Invoicing, Due Dates, Payments and Credits on the Building Automation Service Plans

**Plan fee invoices.** The annual plan fee of a Building Automation Service Plan is invoiced on the tier's billing frequency in equal instalments, with per-point licence fees and the gateway fee carried on the same invoice.

**Due date.** Each invoice falls due the tier's payment term after the invoice date, counted in calendar days with the invoice day excluded and the due day included.

**Late fee — retired basis.** The clause "an invoice unpaid past its due day carries the tier's late fee for each month or part month it stays unpaid", with its arithmetic of the invoice amount multiplied by the tier's late fee rate rounded to two decimal places, is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis on which a late fee is worked out when a plan is settled.

**Extra services — retired basis.** The clause "Extra services — support hours beyond the pool, schedule and graphics work beyond the included counts, alarm response overages and quoted upgrade labor — are invoiced in the month they are performed rather than held to the year end" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis on which controls support work the included hours do not cover is raised.

**Credits.** Credits for a missed acknowledgement target are applied to the next plan invoice.

**Payments.** Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid invoice unless the owner names one.

The billing frequency, the payment term in days and the late fee rate per tier are those of the accounts memorandum on term and billing.

## Instalments by billing frequency

| Billing frequency | Plan fee invoices a year | Each instalment |
|---|---|---|
| annual | 1 | the whole annual plan fee |
| semiannual | 2 | half the annual plan fee |
| quarterly | 4 | a quarter of the annual plan fee |
| monthly | 12 | a twelfth of the annual plan fee |

## Due date illustration (hypothetical)

An invoice dated the 1st of a 31-day month under a 30-day payment term falls due on the 31st: the invoice day is excluded, so the 2nd is day one and the 31st is day thirty, and the due day itself is included in the term. Under a 45-day term the same invoice falls due on the 15th of the following month.

## Payment application (hypothetical)

An owner with two unpaid invoices who sends a payment without naming either has it applied to the older invoice; an owner who names the newer invoice has it applied there.

Extra services — support hours beyond the pool, schedule and graphics work beyond the included counts, alarm response overages and quoted upgrade labor — are invoiced in the month they are performed rather than held to the year end.
